outputs.name: design_packet
outputs.artifact_kind: brief + intent source + module + bundle identities + stop decisions

approvals: named product owner approves every formal decision
every required approver accepts the exact prepared brief digest

failures.recovery: Hold the affected decision; finish independent authorized preparation and request the specific missing decision.
Stop at the unsupported effect boundary; emit design-only handoff labeling uncreated downstream identities.
Return upstream to preparation; never repair the design silently inside qualification.

effects.ceiling: design artifacts in authorized local output paths

determinism.nondeterminism_notes: CLI admission is deterministic over exact bytes; grilling and ratification are human-in-the-loop.

resources.time_budget: design session bounded by the campaign envelope

authority.author: rahulskills
human_gates: Formal construction requires named product-owner ratification and acceptance of the exact prepared brief digest.
Design acceptance alone authorizes no execution, provider dispatch, or spend.
ceiling: design artifacts only; target source receives no mutation authority

acceptance_checks: metabuilder intent check exits zero for the defineIntent rendition
metabuilder harness compile + harness check exit zero for the exact module and bundle
artifact_provenance: compiled and re-admitted module and bundle identities
evidence.report_boundary: No production-readiness claim; explicit qualification handoff only.
